title: Call: the customer - Q3 business review
text:
Title: the customer - Q3 business review
Date: 2026-09-14 10:00 CET
CRM account: acc_024
Participants: CS 1 (Cairnpath, CSM), Customer A (the customer, Head of Analytics), Customer C (the customer, CFO)

[00:00:40] CS 1: Thanks both for making time. I'd like to start with usage, because it's moved since our last review.
[00:01:05] Customer A: Yes, I've seen it. The web side is steady. Mobile looks lower since late August, when the iOS team moved to the new SDK.
[00:01:30] CS 1: Our numbers show about a third of the contract in use this month. Do you think the iOS change explains all of it?
[00:01:52] Customer A: Not all of it. Two of our product squads stopped using the dashboards after the reorg. But iOS is part of it, I'm sure.
[00:02:40] Customer C: I'll be direct. We're reviewing every tool in Q4. The board wants a budget cut of around thirty percent. Cairnpath is on the list.
[00:03:10] CS 1: Understood. If volume is the issue, we can look at the right size for you rather than lose you. 
[00:03:35] Customer A: Realistically we'd be at about 100 million events a year, not the 520 million we bought.
[00:04:20] CS 1: Then here's what I can do: if you renew by 31 January, we'll hold your current price per event, even at the lower volume. I'll confirm it in writing.
[00:04:45] Customer C: That helps. Put it in an email and I'll take it to the board.
[00:05:30] CS 1: I'll also check the iOS issue with our support team.

[00:00:45] CS 1: Congratulations, and thank you for telling me early. What is Customer B like to work with?
[00:01:10] Customer A: Sharp, numbers-first. She wasn't involved when we bought Cairnpath, so she'll question everything. She'll want usage by app before the board.
[00:02:00] CS 1: When does the board decide?
[00:02:10] Customer A: The twelfth of November. The CFO still wants the thirty percent cut. Downsizing is likely; leaving is possible if the iOS numbers stay broken.
[00:02:50] CS 1: Our support team confirmed it's a bug in our iOS SDK. A fix is coming. I'll send Customer B the timeline.
[00:03:30] Customer A: Good. Call me again after the board, the thirteenth or so.
